readThisFirst: Use tokens with tier 'semantic' in product code.
Never use tier 'primitive' or 'primitive-alias' in product code — they are raw values with no intent.
Never use a token with status 'deprecated' or 'experimental' in new code; follow 'replacedBy'.
When filling a shape, take its foreground from 'pairsWith' rather than choosing one.
When a control needs a hover or pressed variant, take it from 'states'.
'contrast.wcag' is computed from the real values: AA (>=4.5:1 text), AA-large (>=3:1), AA-nontext (>=3:1 icons), EXEMPT (intentional), FAIL (do not ship as the only signal).

color-bg.description: Default page background — the lowest layer of any screen. Not for cards or grouped containers (use bg-surface). Resolves to white, same as bg-surface-secondary and bg-fill; pick by role, not by value.

color-bg-surface.description: Background for a grouped container sitting on the page: card, panel, table header, section block. Resolves one step DARKER than `bg` — Cosmos separates layers by tint, not by shadow, so a surface reads as recessed rather than raised.

color-bg-surface-hover.description: Hover state of bg-surface — a clickable card or list row under the cursor.

color-bg-surface-selected.description: Selected state of a clickable container — the chosen card in a set of options. Pair with border-brand to make selection visible without relying on tint alone.

color-bg-surface-disabled.description: Container background for a disabled region or a disabled input field. Pair text with text-disabled and border with border-disabled.

color-bg-surface-secondary.description: Background for a container nested INSIDE bg-surface — an inner card, or a row on a grouped panel. Resolves to white so it reads as raised against the tinted bg-surface.

color-bg-surface-brand.description: Tinted container background for brand-led promotional blocks and highlighted sections. Not an interactive fill — for buttons and selected states use bg-fill-brand.

color-bg-surface-info.description: Tinted container background for informational blocks and inline help. Deliberately uses the brand ramp rather than blue — an intentional product decision, not an error.

color-bg-surface-success.description: Tinted container background for confirmation blocks — booking confirmed, payment received.

color-bg-surface-caution.description: Tinted container background for advisory blocks (yellow intent) — 'fares may change', 'partial refund applies'.
color-bg-surface-caution.note: `caution` is the amber advisory intent. It is scheduled to be renamed to `warning` in a future major version, once the red `warning-*` tokens above have been retired.

color-bg-surface-warning.description: Tinted container background for error and destructive blocks. NOTE: in Cosmos today the `warning` intent is RED (error/destructive), not amber. For amber advisory use `caution`.
color-bg-surface-warning.note: `warning` resolves to red in Cosmos, which reads as error/destructive to most consumers and conflicts with the common convention where warning is amber. Use the identically-valued `danger-*` token instead. These names are reserved so that `warning-*` can be reintroduced as amber in a future major version without silently changing the value of a live token.

color-bg-surface-danger.description: Tinted container background for error and destructive blocks. `danger` is the forward-looking name for the red error/destructive intent. It resolves to exactly the same value as the older `warning-*` token it replaces; `warning` is scheduled to become amber in a future major version, so new code should use `danger`.

color-bg-surface-inverse.description: Container background for inverted regions — dark footers, overlays, tooltips, spotlight sections. Pair foreground with text-inverse and icon-inverse.

color-bg-fill.description: Default fill for an interactive surface in its resting state: unselected button, input field, toggle track. Not a page background (use bg).

color-bg-fill-hover.description: Hover state of bg-fill — an unselected button or input under the cursor. Cosmos state convention: `-hover` is one palette step darker than the resting token, `-active` (pressed) is two.

color-bg-fill-active.description: Pressed/active state of bg-fill. Applies while the pointer is down or the control is being activated by keyboard.

color-bg-fill-selected.description: Selected state of a neutral interactive surface — a chosen row, a checked list item. Tinted with brand so selection reads as a brand affordance. Pair text with text-primary.

color-bg-fill-disabled.description: Fill for a disabled interactive element — disabled button, disabled toggle track. Pair label with text-disabled.

color-bg-fill-secondary.description: Fill for a secondary or tertiary interactive element: secondary button, unselected chip, segmented-control track.

color-bg-fill-secondary-hover.description: Hover state of bg-fill-secondary — secondary button, unselected chip.

color-bg-fill-brand.description: Fill for the primary interactive element on a screen: primary button, active tab, selected chip, checked toggle. Pair foreground with text-brand-on-bg-fill.

color-bg-fill-brand-hover.description: Hover state of bg-fill-brand — primary button under the cursor.

color-bg-fill-brand-subtle.description: Low-emphasis brand fill: tertiary brand button, brand-tinted chip, selected tab background. Pair foreground with text-brand-on-bg-fill-subtle.

color-bg-fill-info-strong.description: High-emphasis informational fill: solid info badge, info banner accent bar. Pair foreground with text-info-on-bg-fill-strong.

color-bg-fill-info-subtle.description: Low-emphasis informational fill: info banner body, subtle info badge. Pair foreground with text-info-on-bg-fill-subtle.

color-bg-fill-success-strong.description: High-emphasis success fill: solid success badge, confirmation accent bar. Pair foreground with text-success-on-bg-fill-strong.

color-bg-fill-success-subtle.description: Low-emphasis success fill: success banner body, subtle success badge. Pair foreground with text-success-on-bg-fill-subtle.

color-bg-fill-caution-strong.description: High-emphasis caution fill (yellow intent): solid caution badge, advisory accent bar. WARNING: the paired text-caution-on-bg-fill-strong fails WCAG AA on this fill — use text-primary on caution fills until the caution ramp is retuned.
color-bg-fill-caution-strong.note: `caution` is the amber advisory intent. It is scheduled to be renamed to `warning` in a future major version, once the red `warning-*` tokens above have been retired.

color-bg-fill-caution-subtle.note: `caution` is the amber advisory intent. It is scheduled to be renamed to `warning` in a future major version, once the red `warning-*` tokens above have been retired.

color-text-primary.description: Default text for headings and body copy — the highest-emphasis foreground. Use for anything the user must read. Contrast against bg: 21.0:1 — passes WCAG AA.

color-text-secondary.description: Supporting text: descriptions, metadata, helper text under an input, secondary list lines. Contrast against bg: 7.23:1 — passes WCAG AA.

color-text-tertiary.description: Lowest-emphasis text: timestamps, captions, section eyebrows. Safe on `bg`, but drops to 4.17:1 on bg-surface — avoid for essential copy on tinted containers. Contrast against bg: 4.54:1 — passes WCAG AA.

color-text-disabled.description: Label text on a disabled control. Intentionally below WCAG AA — WCAG exempts disabled controls from contrast minimums. Never use for enabled content. Contrast against bg: 2.46:1 — FAILS WCAG AA.

contrast.note: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text in a disabled control.

color-text-inverse.description: Text on an inverted or dark background: bg-surface-inverse, bg-fill-inverse, tooltips, toasts. Contrast against bg-surface-inverse: 21.0:1 — passes WCAG AA.

color-text-inverse-disabled.description: Disabled label text on an inverted background. Intentionally below AA (disabled-control exemption). Contrast against bg-surface-inverse: 16.83:1 — passes WCAG AA.

color-text-link.description: Interactive text link inside body copy. Because contrast is below 4.5:1, pair small links with an underline rather than relying on color alone. Contrast against bg: 3.39:1 — passes AA for large text (18px+, or 14px bold) and UI components only; fails for small body text.

color-text-link-hover.description: Hover state of text-link. Keep the underline on hover as well — color alone is not a sufficient affordance.

color-text-brand.description: Brand-colored text used for emphasis outside a link context — a highlighted price, a brand callout. For clickable text use text-link. Contrast against bg: 3.39:1 — passes AA for large text (18px+, or 14px bold) and UI components only; fails for small body text.

color-text-brand-on-bg-fill-subtle.description: Foreground on bg-fill-brand-subtle. Contrast against bg-fill-brand-subtle: 6.6:1 — passes WCAG AA.

color-text-info.description: Informational message text on a plain or lightly-tinted background. Contrast against bg: 6.83:1 — passes WCAG AA.

color-border-secondary.description: Lower-contrast border for dividers INSIDE a container — list row separators, subtle rules.

color-border-focus.description: Keyboard focus ring color. Pair with focus-ring-width and focus-ring-offset so the ring is consistent across components.

color-border-brand.description: Border on a brand-emphasized or selected element: selected card, active tab underline, focused input outline.

color-border-info.description: Border on an informational container — info banner outline, info badge stroke.

color-border-success.description: Border on a success container — confirmation banner outline, success badge stroke.

color-border-caution.description: Border on a caution container — advisory banner outline, caution badge stroke.
color-border-caution.note: `caution` is the amber advisory intent. It is scheduled to be renamed to `warning` in a future major version, once the red `warning-*` tokens above have been retired.

color-border-warning.description: Border on an error container — error banner outline, destructive badge stroke.
color-border-warning.note: `warning` resolves to red in Cosmos, which reads as error/destructive to most consumers and conflicts with the common convention where warning is amber. Use the identically-valued `danger-*` token instead. These names are reserved so that `warning-*` can be reintroduced as amber in a future major version without silently changing the value of a live token.

color-border-danger.description: Border on an error container — error banner outline, destructive badge stroke. `danger` is the forward-looking name for the red error/destructive intent. It resolves to exactly the same value as the older `warning-*` token it replaces; `warning` is scheduled to become amber in a future major version, so new code should use `danger`.

color-icon.description: Default icon color, matching text-primary. Use for icons that carry equal weight to primary text.

color-icon-inverse.description: Icon on an inverted or dark background. Resolves to the same value as bg-surface-disabled — pick by role, not by value.

color-icon-secondary.description: Supporting icon paired with text-secondary — list affordances, metadata icons.

color-icon-tertiary.description: Lowest-emphasis icon: decorative chevrons, inactive indicators. Below 3:1 against `bg`, so never use alone to convey meaning or state.

contrast.note: Decorative only — never the sole carrier of meaning or state.

color-icon-brand.description: Brand-colored icon — active nav item, brand-marked feature.

radius-none.description: Corner radius 0px. Square corners — full-bleed images, flush-joined segments.

radius-xs.description: Corner radius 2px. Smallest rounding — tags, inline code, progress bars.

radius-sm.description: Corner radius 4px. Inputs, small buttons, checkboxes.

radius-md.description: Corner radius 8px. Default rounding — buttons, cards, dropdowns. Start here.

radius-lg.description: Corner radius 12px. Larger cards and grouped panels.

radius-xl.description: Corner radius 16px. Prominent cards, bottom sheets, modals.

radius-2xl.description: Corner radius 24px. Hero cards and large promotional containers.

radius-3xl.description: Corner radius 32px. Full-screen sheets and oversized feature blocks.

radius-4xl.description: Corner radius 40px. Largest rounding — decorative containers only.

radius-full.description: Corner radius 999px. Pill and circle shapes — avatars, chips, icon buttons, toggles.

icon-2xs.description: Icon box size 12px. Inline with small body text — 12px badges and dense tables.

icon-xs.description: Icon box size 16px. Inline with body text, dense list rows.

icon-sm.description: Icon box size 20px. Compact controls — small buttons, input adornments.

icon-md.description: Icon box size 24px. Default icon size — buttons, list items, nav. Start here.

icon-lg.description: Icon box size 32px. Prominent affordances — toolbar actions, card headers.

icon-xl.description: Icon box size 40px. Feature icons in cards and empty states.

icon-2xl.description: Icon box size 48px. Large feature and category icons.

icon-3xl.description: Icon box size 64px. Hero illustration-scale icons and empty-state art.

space-3xs.description: Spacing 2px. Hairline gap — between an icon and its label, or stacked metadata lines.

space-2xs.description: Spacing 4px. Tight gap — chip padding, gap between a label and its input.

space-xs.description: Spacing 8px. Compact gap — inside dense list rows, between related inline elements.

space-sm.description: Spacing 12px. Small gap — button padding, gaps within a form field group.

space-md.description: Spacing 16px. Default gap — card padding and the standard gap between related blocks. Start here.

space-lg.description: Spacing 20px. Comfortable gap — between distinct groups inside a card.

space-xl.description: Spacing 24px. Section gap — between cards in a list.

space-3xl.description: Spacing 32px. Gap between major page sections.

space-7xl.description: Spacing 64px. Largest gap — hero and landing-page section separation.

border-width-none.description: No border. Use to remove a border in a variant without special-casing.

border-width-thin.description: Default border width — inputs, cards, dividers, table cells. Start here.

border-width-thick.description: Emphasised border — selected cards, active tab underline, focus rings.

border-width-thicker.description: Heaviest border — decorative accent bars and left-edge banner rules.

focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring. Use with border-focus and focusRing.offset so focus looks identical on every component.

focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focused element's edge and its focus ring, so the ring stays visible against the element's own border.

motion-duration-instant.description: Near-imperceptible change — hover tints, focus rings, checkbox marks. Use when the user should register the result, not the motion.

motion-duration-fast.description: Default UI feedback — button presses, tooltips, small fades. Start here for anything the user triggers directly.

motion-duration-normal.description: Elements entering or leaving — dropdowns, popovers, toasts, accordions.

motion-duration-slow.description: Large surfaces travelling a long distance — bottom sheets, full-screen modals, page transitions. Do not use for small controls; it reads as lag.

motion-easing-enter.description: For elements appearing: menus, tooltips, toasts, sheets opening. Pair with motion.duration.normal.

motion-easing-exit.description: For elements disappearing: dismissing a sheet, closing a menu. Pair with motion.duration.fast — exits should be quicker than entrances.

motion-easing-move.description: For elements that stay on screen while changing position or size — reordering a list, expanding a card. Default choice.

motion-easing-emphasis.description: For hero moments that should draw the eye — a confirmation animation, an onboarding reveal. Use sparingly.
